helpers.name: computeBondStatus
helpers.purpose: Compute a bond's status (Danger / On-going / Completed) from its payment months, tenure and maturity amount, with the fixed Danger rule (any unpaid past month, not just the previous calendar month); Completed overrides Danger.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm: 'status rules migrate from VBA with fixes — Danger = any unpaid past month (not just previous month), Completed overrides, zero-value = unpaid preserved'
brainstorm DOC-CODE-ANALYST: 'Status engine (col A): Danger = previous calendar month cell empty (single-month check only); Completed = months paid >= tenure (overrides Danger); else On-going'

doc-code section 4.4: 'Danger only if the PREVIOUS calendar month cell is empty/0 (single month); older missed payments stay invisible. Completed (paymentsMade >= tenure) overrides Danger. Zero-value entry counts as unpaid.'
doc-code section 7(d): 'status rules (fixing the single-month Danger quirk)'
inputs: payments: list of {month: 'YYYY-MM', amount: number, paid: boolean} for one bond
tenureMonths: int (Tenure (Months), Monthly Returns col H)
errors: throws/returns error when payments list is empty
throws/returns error when asOfMonth is not a valid 'YYYY-MM' month

helpers.name: computeTillReturnAndBalance
helpers.purpose: Compute a bond's Till Return amount (sum of all received month amounts) and Balance amount (Till Return minus Maturity Amount), reproducing Excel formulas K = SUM(months received) and L = K - J.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm DOC-CODE-ANALYST: 'K = SUM(months received), L = K - J (Maturity Amount)'
doc-code section 2.3: 'K = SUM(N:XFD) injected by VBA ... L = K-J injected by VBA, J/Maturity Amount is a static typed value'
doc-code section 5.3: 'L = Balance Amount = Dashboard Total Balance (negative = still to receive)'
doc-code section 7(c): 'derived totals as queries'
inputs: paidAmounts: list of number (received month amounts for one bond)
outputs: balanceAmount: number (tillReturnAmount - maturityAmount; negative = still to receive)
errors: throws/returns error when maturityAmount is not a number
throws/returns error when paidAmounts contains a negative or non-numeric value

helpers.name: computeThisMonthReturns
helpers.purpose: Compute the total of all bond payments received in the current calendar month (reproduces Dashboard E6 = SUM(current month column)), without the Excel fallback-to-static-0 quirk.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm DOC-CODE-ANALYST: 'E6 = SUM(current month column)'
doc-code section 2.4: 'E6=SUM(Z)=1394.62 "This Month Returns (Sep-26)" (dynamic, Z = Sep-26)'
doc-code section 4.7: 'E6 This Month Returns falls back to static 0 when current month header not found'
brainstorm Decision Summary: dashboard as live queries includes 'this-month returns'
inputs: payments: list of {bondId: string, month: 'YYYY-MM', amount: number, paid: boolean}
outputs: total: number (sum of paid amounts for asOfMonth)
errors: throws/returns error when asOfMonth is not a valid 'YYYY-MM' month

helpers.name: aggregateMonthlyHistory
helpers.purpose: Aggregate the full project history table: for each month in the plan window (Sep-2025..Jul-2032), compute total received, with future months as 0 — reproducing the Dashboard history table L5:M87 (83 months).
sourceRequirements: brainstorm DOC-CODE-ANALYST: 'History table L5:M87 = 83 months (Sep-25..Jul-32), Sep-26 row (r17) yellow-highlighted, future months = 0'
doc-code section 2.4: 'History table L5:M87 = 83 months (Sep-25..Jul-32), future months = 0'
brainstorm Decision Summary: dashboard as live queries includes '83-month history'
doc-code section 4.2 (quirk fixed): 'FindStartingMonthColumn scans cols 14..78 (through Jan-2031)' — history must cover the whole window, not stop at Jan-2031
inputs: payments: list of {month: 'YYYY-MM', amount: number, paid: boolean}
outputs: rows: list of {month: 'YYYY-MM', totalReceived: number, isFuture: boolean} — one row per month, future months totalReceived = 0
errors: throws/returns error when a payment month lies outside [windowStart, windowEnd]

helpers.name: parseXlsmImport
helpers.purpose: Parse v5.5_40L_Project_Tracker.xlsm (Bond - Watch list, Monthly Returns, Home Plan sheets) into normalized records (bond master, payment ledger, home plan rows) for one-time import into SQLite, tolerating verbatim header typos.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm Decision Summary / Agreed Q2: 'One-time Python script imports the .xlsm into SQLite; Excel kept as read-only backup'
brainstorm: 'Migration must reproduce: bond master, payment ledger, derived totals as queries, status rules, dashboard views, watch-list analytics, Home Plan schedule'
doc-code section 5.2: 'Header typos (verbatim): Staus, Yeild, ISN, Till Rerun Amount , Payment type Type, Quartely, Totall, Intrest'
doc-code section 7: 'A SQLite migration must reproduce: (a) bond master table, (b) monthly payment ledger, (c) derived totals as queries'
outputs: bonds: list of bond master records (ISN, company, rating, face value, principle, tenure, maturity date/amount, start month, payment type)
payments: list of ledger records {bond isn, month, amount, paid}
homePlan: list of {monthIndex, saving, rate, interest, countdown, monthlyInterest}
warnings: list of str (rows/columns skipped or ambiguous)
errors: throws when file missing or not a valid .xlsm zip
throws when required sheets ('Bond - Watch list ', 'Monthly Returns', 'Home Plan') are absent
throws when a required header column cannot be located; row-level issues go to warnings instead of failing the whole import

helpers.name: exportCsv
helpers.purpose: Export a given dataset (dashboard summary, bond list, payment history, monthly history) to CSV for sharing/printing, replacing Excel as the export front end.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm Decision Summary: 'CSV export' in new-fr list
brainstorm Agreed Q4: 'Is CSV/Excel export needed once Excel is no longer the front end? A: Yes, CSV export for sharing/printing'
doc-code section 4.12: 'any xlsx/CSV/DB export loses all behavior ... unless reimplemented'
inputs: columns: list of str (column order / display names)
outputs: written file at destinationPath; returns row count written
errors: throws when destinationPath is not writable
throws when rows is empty or a row lacks a key from columns
throws on encoding failure (file must be written UTF-8)

helpers.name: computeMonthWindow
helpers.purpose: Compute the full payment-grid month window (start month through end month, e.g. Sep-2025..Jul-2032 = 96 columns) and locate any month's column index, replacing the hardcoded Sep-2025..Feb-2027 header generation and the Jan-2031 scan limit.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm DOC-CODE-ANALYST: 'payment grid Sep-2025 -> Jul-2032 (96 month columns)'; 'Quirks to fix in migration: headers hardcoded Sep-2025..Feb-2027; month scan stops Jan-2031'
doc-code section 4.1: 'RegenerateMonthlyHeaders writes Sep-2025..Feb-2027 (cols 14-31) only'
doc-code section 4.2: 'FindStartingMonthColumn scans cols 14..78 (through Jan-2031) — a bond starting Feb-2031+ silently gets no formatting/status'
brainstorm Agreed Q3: 'Excel-like month-grid rendered by the UI; totals/status become live queries; fixes hardcoded headers, Jan-2031 scan limit'
outputs: months: list of 'YYYY-MM' covering the whole window (derived, never hardcoded)
monthIndex: int (0-based index of targetMonth within months) when targetMonth given
errors: throws when targetMonth is outside [gridStart, gridEnd]

helpers.name: computeTenureWindow
helpers.purpose: Given a bond's interest starting month and tenure, compute the payment months due (start..start+tenure-1) and the maturity month/date, driving ledger generation, status checks and grid rendering.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm DOC-CODE-ANALYST: 'Monthly Returns ... M (start month)'; 'Tenure (Months) col H, Maturity Date col I'
doc-code section 3.2: 'Worksheet_Change fires FormatRowPaymentTracking when column H (tenure), M (start month) or >=14 (month cells) change'
doc-code section 4.4: 'Completed (paymentsMade >= tenure)'
doc-code section 7: 'monthly payment ledger' must span the bond's months
errors: throws when startMonth is not a valid 'YYYY-MM'

helpers.name: mapPaymentStatusStyle
helpers.purpose: Map a payment cell state (paid / due / unpaid-past) and a bond status to its display colors: green paid, light red due; status colors red (Danger) / orange (On-going) / green (Completed), replacing Excel conditional formatting.
sourceRequirements: brainstorm DOC-CODE-ANALYST: 'Colors: green paid / light red due; status colors via CF (red/orange/green)'
doc-code section 2.3: 'CF: A-column cellIs rules for Danger/Completed/On-going colors'
doc-code section 4.9: 'CF duplicate-ISIN highlight only covers D7 and D14:D16 ... partial' (migration must apply coloring uniformly)
doc-code section 4.12: 'any xlsx/CSV/DB export loses all behavior (dashboard, status, coloring) unless reimplemented'
outputs: cellColor: str (e.g. '#green') for the month cell
statusColor: str (red/orange/green) for the status label
errors: throws when cellState or status is not one of the allowed values

notes: All 9 helpers trace to explicit statements in the brainstorm notes or doc-code analysis (zero-hallucination, FR-22); each sourceRequirements entry quotes the originating text. The fr-extractor report was not present under prd/ at run time, so FR-N ids are not attached yet — a later pass can map HF-NN to FR-Ns once fr-extractor's JSON exists. Helpers excluded as queries/views rather than shared functions: dashboard summary counts/totals (brainstorm: 'dashboard as live queries') and duplicate-ISIN flag (single consumer = import validation, inside HF-05). All helpers are pure/testable with no I/O except HF-05 and HF-06.
